style.styleTitle: Everlands Windham Spruce Frosted Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>The Everlands 7ft Windham Frosted Christmas Tree is perfect for creating a stunning festive display in any home.</p><p>This beautiful tree stands out with its realistic appearance, crafted from a mix of PE and PVC materials. The frosted finish adds a touch of winter magic, emulating the charm of a snow-dusted forest. Notably, the Windham family is known for its luxurious and natural appearance, thanks to the inclusion of pinecones that enhance its overall aesthetic.&nbsp;</p><ul><li>7ft tall with a 130 cm diameter<br></li><li>Hard needle and soft needle branches<br></li><li>Frosted finish for a wintery look including artificial berries and pinecones<br></li><li>12 year warranty when you register online</li></ul><p>This tree promises not only a traditional look but a modern twist with its frosty finish, ready to bring joy and cheer to every home.&nbsp;</p>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This delightful Everlands Windham Mini Christmas Tree is perfect for adding a touch of Christmas spirit to any indoor space. Its hard and soft needle design is highlighted by natural-looking pinecones and cheerful red berries, bringing a vibrant and festive feel to any room. The tree sits in a sturdy pot with a foot diameter of 14 cm, making it an ideal centrepiece for a table or desk. - Height: 2ft, Diameter: 42 cm - Frosted finish with berries and pinecones - Hard and soft needle design - Suitable for indoor use - Comes in a stable pot with a 14 cm diameter This mini tree is a wonderful way to bring the outdoors inside with its realistic features and classic charm, ensuring a cosy and festive ambiance.
